def _no_op_aligner(
    *,

    output_file: Path,
    config: AlignmentConfig,  # noqa: ARG001
) -> Path:
    assert query_fasta.exists()
    lines = []
    for line in query_fasta.read_text().splitlines():
        if line.startswith(">"):
            query_id = line[1:]
            chrom, start, end = query_id.rsplit("_", 2)
            length = int(end) - int(start)
            lines.append(
                f"{query_id}\t{chrom}\t100\t{length}\t0\t0\t1\t{length}\t"
                f"{int(start) + 1}\t{end}\t0\t100"
            )
    output_file.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n")

def test_classification_stage_assigns_probe_metadata(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    """无 BED 目录时仍完成分级并注入 probe_type / data_type。"""
    cfg = _make_config(tmp_path)
    recorder = NoopPerformanceRecorder()
    aligned = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            ProbeColumn.PROBE_ID: ["chr1_61_100"],
            ProbeColumn.SEQUENCE: ["A" * 40],
            ProbeColumn.GENOME_HITS: [0],
        }
    )
    assert_schema(aligned, PipelineStage.AFTER_ALIGNMENT)

    classified = ClassificationStage().run(
        seq_df=aligned,
        config=cfg,
        probe_type=ProbeType.CENTER,
        data_type=DataType.SNP,
        recorder=recorder,
    )

    assert_schema(classified, PipelineStage.AFTER_CLASSIFY)
    assert classified.iloc[0][ProbeColumn.PROBE_TYPE] == ProbeType.CENTER
    assert classified.iloc[0][ProbeColumn.DATA_TYPE] == DataType.SNP
    assert ProbeColumn.PROBE_LEVEL in classified.columns
